title: 修正既有Workshop重新載入未讀取canonical策略身分
final_head_binding: Canonical handoff binds the exact final PR head containing this manifest via REVIEW_HEAD_SHA.

sanitized_source_input.observed_defect: Existing Workshop initial navigation and reload did not invoke listWorkshopVersions(workshopId), leaving strategySpecIdentity null until a later stream event and keeping ResearchPlanPanel disabled despite canonical owner versions existing.

acceptance_verification.AC1_initial_load_and_remount_canonical_i: WorkshopSessionView reads listWorkshopVersions(workshopId) during initial load/remount inside the [workshopId] useEffect and refreshes on workshop.snapshot SSE events, deriving strategySpecIdentity exclusively via the existing canonicalStrategySpecIdentity(versions) parser while preserving immutable strategy_id and registry_id semantics.
acceptance_verification.AC2_resource_change_reset_and_cancellati: On workshopId change, WorkshopSessionView immediately resets strategySpecIdentity to null, guards initial load resolution with the existing cancelled effect flag, and guards refreshStrategySpec callbacks with activeWorkshopIdRef.current === workshopId so late responses from a prior Workshop are ignored and missing/failed owner versions keep ResearchPlanPanel disabled with tenant/auth/write and role checks intact.
acceptance_verification.AC3_regression_coverage_and_preserved_di: Added 4 regression tests in src/agora/pages/strategy-workshop/StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx proving: (1) initial load and browser-equivalent remount hydration of canonical StrategySpec identity enabling createWorkshopResearchPlan while preserving durable synthesis and Research result display; (2) write-access and role guards preventing Research Plan creation even when canonical identity is hydrated; (3) failed/missing/non-canonical owner version responses keeping Research Plan creation disabled despite visible labels or local events; and (4) resource switching clearing previous identity and ignoring delayed prior-workshop responses.
acceptance_verification.AC4_scoped_footprint_and_delivery_bounda: Modified only the 3 declared artifacts. Production diff is +8/-3 lines (net +5, within <= 40 budget) and this evidence manifest is under 400 lines. No VM, SSH, product login, real provider, or hosted business action was invoked. Root retains combined final exact-pair qualification/release.
